'''December 2001 Sydney Theed Palace Sealed Deck tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG sealed deck held in Sydney, Australia in December 2001. [[Jared Brown]] won it. It is known from Clarrie Brown's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3182">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-17-sydney-theed-palace-sealed-deckd3182/ sydney-theed-palace-sealed-deck], DeckTech (clarrie " DLOTSuckers" brown, 17 December 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-17-sydney-theed-palace-sealed-deckd3182/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' December 2001
* '''Site:''' Sydney, Australia
* '''Format:''' [[Sealed Deck]]
* '''Players:''' 8
* '''Winner:''' [[Jared Brown]]
